prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. Her hand at the shoe slides the yellow card out of the window and drags it flat along the felt under its fingertips towards its place in the middle of the picture, where the last frame shows it. On the way her thumb and fingers take the card at its edge, and her wrist turns over once: her palm comes from facing down to facing up, and the card comes over with her hand, blue side up. With her hand still turned, she lays the card flat at its place and lets go of it; only then does her empty hand turn palm down. Then her open hand glides back low over the felt, palm down, to the shoe and rests over the next card in the window. The other hand rests on the felt. Only one card moves. The card is plain, one flat solid yellow from edge to edge on its back and one flat solid blue from edge to edge on its face, and the next card in the window is the same plain solid yellow.
